_comment: AC-14's bundle baseline, as measured — not as remembered. `-065` refused to quote this number in its own record
and rebuilt `41b32af` in the same run instead, because subtracting a five-hour-old figure from a fresh build
measures two afternoons rather than one milestone. A per-PR CI gate cannot do that: actions/checkout defaults to
depth 1, and rebuilding the baseline commit on every push costs four builds for a number that changes only when
someone edits a dependency. So the quoted value returns here as a *fixture with provenance*, and the counterweight
is `bundle-baseline-recheck` in ci.yml: a dispatch-only job that re-runs tests/build/bundleDelta.sh, which rebuilds
both trees, and fails if this file no longer reproduces byte-for-byte.
The URL literal is part of the number, not a detail: `import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL` is inlined into the bundle,
so `localhost` (9 chars) and the sandbox IP (14 chars) differ by 9 gzip bytes on identical code — measured in
`-065`. A gate built at a different literal than this one is not measuring the same thing.
measured_by: tests/build/bundleDelta.sh at head b489f18, four builds in one run
reproduction: byte-exact: 60118 and 61368 matched Slice 0's 05:25 UTC figures to 0 bytes
build_command: VITE_API_BASE_URL=<url> npm run build && cat dist/assets/*.js | gzip -c | wc -c
